notes.title: Patch notes 8/9/18
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where attack speed was negatively affected at high framerates.

- Fixed the way SE and voice volume are handled.
  This should address:
[list][*] Environment sounds being louder than expected.
[*]Difficulty hearing enemy death cries.
[*]Lowering of volume sliders not having any noticeable effect.
[*]Footfalls being too quiet.[/list]
  As well as other related issues.

The above-noted fix has affected the defaults for all volume sliders, setting it to 7 across the board. If you find that this makes any part of the game too loud next time you play, you may adjust it to your preference via the Options menu.

- Fixed an issue where certain graphics resolutions were not populating the list of available resolutions on GPD WIN2 and similar machines.

- Adjusted the launcher window layout to better facilitate showing all buttons and character portaits even on 1280x720 displays.

- Added a feature to the in-game options that allows players to disable the ability to perform simultaneous Flash Guard and Flash Move ("Simulflash").

notes.title: Patch notes 8/3/18
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Here with another update.

- Added an option to the launcher to automatically generate mipmaps for textures applied to 3D models.

- Added a keyboard action for "walk." Pressing and holding this key will allow the player characters to walk instead of run during gameplay.

- Set the default display language to always be English on the very first bootup of the game. (The display language can be changed via the launcher.)

- Corrected a typo in the game's ending credits.

The updates for GOG and Humble will be going out on Monday, 8/6/18. In the future, we'll be testing and deploying them all simultaneously! Thank you for your patience :actionadol:

notes.title: Patch notes 7/27/18
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thank you for your support in our launch of [i]Ys: Memories of Celceta[/i]! Our first patch is up and running for you guys. Here are the changes:

- Flash guard can now be performed multiple times in quick succession
- Button prompts for mouse buttons now appear correctly when remapped
- Flash guard can now be performed immediately after swimming
- Modified installation dependencies to fix a launching issue for some users

Please continue to post any issues to the pinned bug threads and email any in-depth details to support@xseedgames.com
